text: Rationale: revision IDs already anchor RunStamp, archive addresses, reporting and bindings; family-local renumbering or deriving family from revision name would corrupt those identities or make rename create a new analysis. A distinct registry avoids invasive changes to every scientific carrier and can preserve implicit legacy bytes. No source can safely read multi-family projects while Freshness globally compares newest runs/drafts; persistence and interpretation therefore share one safety boundary. Seeded provisional origins reuse q-initial-analysis-draft principles, prevent synthetic histories, and avoid phantom saved families on discard. This contract was independently reviewed by Astra high; adversarial coverage includes duplicate names, ownership cardinality, interleaved A/B completion/activity/drafts, exact legacy replay and old-codec relabel rejection. Initial foundation does not enable multi-family document payloads.
